What have you done to look into a home purchase? Like, have you tried to get approved, or has the market turned you off from trying? How are your debts?

It doesn't hurt to take a look at all of these things every couple of years, fix what you can and check again later. I'm not sure what kind of financing programs there are in AU other than just a bank mortgage (US has FHA and USDA financing, for example), but it won't hurt to talk to someone about it.

If you have a pile of debt, you could try snowballing the debt to pay it off faster. Keep credit lines open but pay them down so your debt to income ratio is lower.

I looked at houses for sale in South Australia, and they are pretty crazy! I looked at minimum wage and average salaries, too, and even though the prices are high for homes, it seems slightly more doable than if those prices were in US in expensive areas. I'm not trying to say you're doing things wrong, but don't give up until you've exhausted all possibilities if this is something you really want.

You could also look into foreclosures or short sale places. If you do get pre-approved for a smaller than ideal amount, a realtor may be able to help you find those kinds of properties, but there may be more work bringing the property up to code.

Good luck, I hope you can have your own home someday soon.
